description: In combination with `histSST`, quantifies the transient aerosol effective radiative forcing (ERF) over the historical period. Same as `histSST`, except anthropogenic aerosol and aerosol precursor (BC, OC, NH3, SO2) emissions are held at 1850 values. Atmosphere-only counterpart of `hist-piAer`.
branch_information: Branch from `piControl` at a time of your choosing
